entities.summary: Karl Adolph Gjellerup was a Danish poet and novelist who together with his compatriot Henrik Pontoppidan won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1917. He is associated with the Modern Breakthrough period of Scandinavian literature. He occasionally used the pseudonym Epigonos. Karl Adolph Gjellerup was a authors & novelists from Roholte (1857-06-02, Roholte–1919-10-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
